subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram slash sessions still resolve to channel=(unknown), causing elevated allowFrom checks to fail on 2026.3.13

question: Which fix path should own the Telegram slash-session channel identity repair for elevated `allowFrom` diagnostics?
rationale: The remaining bug is source-visible and touches elevated host-command authorization, while two open fork PRs propose different repair shapes that are not merged proof.

options.title: Adopt the scoped-key normalization fix
options.body: Use the mergeable candidate shape that scopes non-agent colon session keys before lookup, then add focused regression and live Telegram proof before landing.

options.title: Choose the static registry fallback
options.body: Use the alternate channel-registry fallback only if maintainers want `sandbox explain` to infer bare channel prefixes without normalizing the session key first.

options.title: Pause for live repro first
options.body: Require a maintainer-run Telegram elevated exec repro before choosing between candidate repairs, leaving this issue open as the canonical tracker.

recommendation.title: Adopt the scoped-key normalization fix
recommendation.body: Use the mergeable candidate shape that scopes non-agent colon session keys before lookup, then add focused regression and live Telegram proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent session metadata and sandbox diagnostics history makes this the best available routing owner for the security-sensitive fix-shape choice.
